rules.title: HPD Policy 463 — Public Recording of Law Enforcement Activity
applies_to: lawful public or legally present private vantage
rules.summary: HPD recognizes lawful recording of law-enforcement activity and distinguishes recording from actual interference. The full implementation and any separate visitor rule remain to be tested; this policy does not establish a building-wide camera ban.
open_questions: Any separate lobby/visitor recording rule, sign, post order, or implementation guidance?
What revisions and effective dates control?

rules.title: HPD identification — requested ID-card display and uniform identification
rules.summary: Section 1045.2.1 directs courteous display of the department ID card on request as soon as practical, with commander-directed specialized-assignment exceptions. Section 1045.2.3 separately requires a visible badge and worn nameplate. The card contains a member identification number; do not assume it equals the badge number. The text does not expressly require oral recitation of both identifiers.
open_questions: Policy-specific effective dates and implementation guidance on requests for an officer’s name or badge number.

rules.title: HPD Policy 1019 — complaint intake
rules.summary: The policy provides oral and written complaint intake and supervisory routing. Reconcile complaint-form availability with published lobby hours. These staff obligations are not visitor restrictions.

cpra_targets.target: Unpublished current headquarters visitor/recording directives, signage authority, public-access plans, and implementation guidance for Policies 463, 1045, and 1019.
cpra_targets.why: The full manual is already public; seek implementation gaps and version history rather than duplicate it.
